description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks." The horizontal category axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," displays nine discrete categories with angled labels in the following order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical value axis is labeled "Score (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 10. The chart utilizes grouped bars to represent two different models, as indicated by the legend titled "Model": "LLaMA-3-8B-it" is represented by blue bars positioned on the left of each group, and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" is represented by brown bars positioned on the right. Across the categories, the highest scores are observed in the GSM-8K category, where the LLaMA-3-8B-it bar reaches approximately 79% and the Ours (Iterative RLHF) bar reaches approximately 80%. Conversely, the lowest score is found in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, where the LLaMA-3-8B-it bar measures approximately 20%, while the corresponding Ours (Iterative RLHF) bar is approximately 29%. Other approximate values include TruthfulQA, with LLaMA-3-8B-it at roughly 44% and Ours (Iterative RLHF) at 60%, and LC AlpacaEval-2, with values near 23% and 31%, respectively. The categories do not appear to be sorted by alphabetical order or by ascending or descending values, and there are no specific visual emphases such as annotations or outlines applied to individual bars.
